body:
We should add CI/CD tool that is able to detect watermarking and fail CI/CD asking to use the same tool with --fix using simple source code.

Check https://github.com/guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover and all the competitors, and double check that all watermarking from all AI systems known to date are fully removed.

We should support such features like line breaker normalization, BOM normalization (either all files without or with it).

Encoding normalization - remove all files except exceptions that are needed the way they are to UTF-8 (the most popular and supported encoding).

Propose 10-20 names for this service with much more general name.

FInd all related services that are related to encodings/special characters and so on, so we have all the features and beat exactly all competitors, but instead of making skills/hooks/plugins we use good old school CI/CD support, which is much more reliable and efficient.

Use as much of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/refs/heads/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md as possible, prefer links notation as configuration over json, make sure it is highly readable for humans and easy to edit manually.

The goal for source code to be produced in highest possible quality, and don't trigger any unexpected behavior or just get in a way with legitimate work process.

So all invisible special characters that are not in allowed languages must be stripped away, so there must be nothing unreadable for humans un unicode messing around with the code itself.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Take all ideas for text watermarking from the internet, and make sure source code and docs are not polluted with any of these
